key_insight: This review highlights how AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging can help map nanoscale thermal properties and reveal heat transport shaped by interfaces and defects.
engineering_relevance: Improved thermal mapping could support materials discovery and thermal management in heterogeneous electronics and advanced manufacturing.
method: Use non-contact pump–probe thermoreflectance with wide-field imaging or scanning.
Apply AI-assisted processing to characterize thermal properties, interfaces, and subsurface features.
Explore heat-carrier spectral mapping, 3D property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental design.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a review of recent advances but reports no datasets, quantitative benchmarks, or accuracy metrics.
watch_item: Reliable deployment must balance imaging throughput with accuracy while resolving multiple thermal parameters with high confidence.
paper_title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
